entries.text: The bundled SQLGlot runtime moves from 30.24.0.2 to 30.24.0.3 (fork commit `a4dad47db8ca`). A translation corpus of every shipped benchmark query across the 20 target dialects and `questdb` (1,262 queries, 26,502 translations, no errors in either runtime) changes in 40 outputs. Results published before this change for the affected queries on SQLite were computed with different SQL:
details: SQLite, day offsets on a date column compared with date text: 30.24.0.2 wrote `DATETIME(DATE(..), 'N DAY')`, whose `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` text sorts after the date text of the same day, so a lower bound excluded the boundary-day rows and a `<` upper bound included them. The runtime now writes `DATE(DATE(..), 'N DAY')`. TPC-DS queries 5, 12, 16, 20, 21, 32, 37, 40, 77, 80, 82, 92, 94, 95 and 98 (15 outputs), the same queries in `tpcds_obt` (12 outputs), TPC-H Q1, TPC-H Skew Q1 and ten TPC-Havoc `1_v*` variants.

BigQuery `3_v9` in TPC-Havoc: the runtime drops `NULLS LAST` from the window `ORDER BY` of `FIRST_VALUE` when the key is a `PARTITION BY` key, because BigQuery rejects a non-default NULL ordering there and the key is constant within a partition.
